title: Improve feed error diagnostics, backend availability checks, and retry UX

requirements.summary: Add a frontend-visible backend availability check to classify feed load failures as propagation/unreachable vs application error.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend calls the existing lightweight backend heartbeat capability when the feed load fails and labels the error as either 'Backend unreachable/not propagated' vs 'Backend reachable but request failed'.
When the backend is unreachable, the UI messaging explicitly suggests propagation delay and next steps (wait, retry, try raw URL), rather than a generic error.

file_operations.description: Create a small hook that uses the existing actor to call the backend heartbeat function (checkBackendHeartbeat) with conservative guards (only when actor is available) and returns an availability state (e.g., unknown/checking/reachable/unreachable) plus any diagnostic error text for UI display.

Integrate the backend availability hook into the feed error flow: when loading stories fails, trigger the availability check and use the result to render distinct messaging for (a) unreachable/not propagated vs (b) reachable-but-request-failed; ensure the unreachable message recommends waiting for propagation, retrying, and trying the raw URL.

requirements.summary: Enhance the Feed page 'Failed to load stories' error UI with actionable troubleshooting, canister details, and one-click actions.
acceptanceCriteria: On the Feed page error state, display a clear heading and short explanation that the website loaded but the backend may be unavailable or still propagating.
Include buttons/links: Retry now, Open Troubleshooting page, and Open raw.icp0.io URL (when detectable).

Display detected canister info using existing canister resolution utilities (frontend canister ID/source, backend canister ID when available, standard/raw URLs) with copy-to-clipboard actions or a clear path to copy (can reuse existing UI patterns from TroubleshootingPage).
All user-facing text is in English and avoids vague messages like only 'Failed to load stories' without next steps.

file_operations.description: Add a reusable Feed diagnostics UI block for the error state: uses existing canister resolution utilities (getCanisterInfo) to show frontend asset canister ID/source, backend canister ID (when available), standard/raw URLs, and provides copy-to-clipboard actions and external-open actions. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Replace the current destructive Alert-only error state with an actionable error layout: include Retry now, a link/button to the existing /troubleshooting route, and an external link to the raw URL when available; render the new FeedDiagnosticsPanel and incorporate the backend availability classification messaging from REQ-1. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Extend/adjust canister URL utilities as needed to support Feed error actions reliably (e.g., exposing enough info to decide when raw URL is detectable and to display a clear 'unknown' state) while keeping existing TroubleshootingPage behavior intact.

requirements.summary: Implement improved retry/backoff for the published stories fetch and show progress feedback during the initial 10–15 seconds after page load.
acceptanceCriteria: When the backend request fails, the UI shows a visible 'Retrying…' / 'Checking backend…' state rather than immediately settling into a static failure state after 1–2 seconds.
Retry timing uses a backoff strategy (increasing delays) up to a reasonable cap, and stops after a finite number of attempts with a final actionable error state.
A manual 'Retry now' action is always available in the final error state.

file_operations.description: Update useGetPublishedStories react-query settings to use an increasing backoff (e.g., exponential with a cap) and a finite retry count tuned to cover roughly the first ~10–15 seconds; ensure failures ultimately settle into a final error state and that manual refetch remains available.

Add a visible in-between state for the feed while retries/backoff are happening after an initial failure (e.g., 'Checking backend…' / 'Retrying…' with attempt feedback derived from react-query state such as failureCount/isFetching), and ensure the final error state still provides a prominent 'Retry now' action.
